_about: Buildings and street furniture for Huskhaven as a small town (decision 0016). Described as solid chunky shapes with no thatch and no thin parts, because those shatter in 3D generation; meant for the coarse workflow.

subjects.subject: A cosy two-storey village inn, cream plaster walls with dark timber beams, a round green door, a small covered porch, one fat stone chimney, a carved wooden sign board fixed flat above the door. One solid building as a single chunky shape with thick smooth walls, a roof of large overlapping wooden shingles, deep-set windows and door modelled as shallow insets, no thatch, no thin poles, no hanging things, no fences, no plants, nothing loose around it.

A village smithy: a squat stone building with one wide open archway at the front, a big square stone forge chimney, a heavy timber roof. One solid building as a single chunky shape with thick smooth walls, a roof of large overlapping wooden shingles, deep-set windows and door modelled as shallow insets, no thatch, no thin poles, no hanging things, no fences, no plants, nothing loose around it.

One solid building as a single chunky shape with thick smooth walls, a roof of large overlapping wooden shingles, deep-set windows and door modelled as shallow insets, no thatch, no thin poles, no hanging things, no fences, no plants, nothing loose around it.

One straight section of a town wall: a low thick wall of pale stone blocks with a walkway of heavy planks on top and a row of chunky pointed wooden stakes along the outer edge, seen from the front, long and low, solid simple shapes, no thin parts, nothing around it.

A town gate: two stout square stone gate towers joined by a thick timber beam roof over an open passage wide enough for a cart, the passage empty and open, solid chunky shapes, no doors, no chains, no thin parts, nothing around it.
A village lantern post: a short thick carved wooden post with one big round paper lantern fixed solidly on top, chunky toy-like shapes, no chains, no thin parts.

A small roadside shrine: a smooth cream seed-husk the size of a barrel standing upright on a ring of flat stones, split open at the front to show a hollow lined with pale moss, solid simple shapes, no glow, no thin parts.

A village well-fountain: a wide round low stone basin with a short thick stone pillar in the middle topped by a carved stone seed, the basin filled with flat opaque blue-green water, solid chunky shapes, no spray, no thin parts.
A village notice board: two thick wooden posts holding a broad plank board with a small shingle roof on top, a few square paper notices painted flat on the board, chunky solid shapes.
A round hay bale tied with two thick ropes, simple solid shape, no loose straw.
